title: Partitioning: vertical, horizontal and federation

kcs.statement: Partitioning splits one dataset across nodes so each holds a fraction of the data and serves a fraction of the queries, which raises write capacity where replication alone cannot.
Vertical partitioning splits data by columns or tables, while horizontal partitioning splits the rows of one table by a key value.
Federation splits a database by function, such as separate users, products and orders databases, which cuts per-database load but turns cross-function queries into application-side joins.
